prompt.label: Prompt
prompt.value: Photographic moonflower garden at blue dusk, based on the supplied photograph. A stabilized camera slides slowly right along the real stone wall, with close heart-shaped leaves crossing the foreground and deeper white trumpet flowers shifting in parallax. A light breeze moves leaves and flexible stems from the first frame. Keep the main central flowers crisp, naturally attached, and unchanged in shape through the ending. Preserve the same plant and wall. Soft restrained twilight, natural depth and gentle movement; no new flowers, melting petals, text, people, glow or cuts.

prompt.value: Photographic blue-hour garden with the same stone wall, white moonflowers, wooden support, terracotta pot, curved path and lawn.
